name: Amaenbo Fuyu
source:
After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.

Revisit the peaceful, seaside town, and spend time catching up with your family and friends.

What new memories will you make this winter?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2495450]Steam[/url]]
translation:
半年前，你留下了难忘的夏日回忆。如今，结衣、莉音与美雪又回来了。季节更迭，寒雪飘落，你的故事也即将翻开新的一页。

重返那座宁静的海滨小镇，与家人、朋友重聚，聊聊彼此的近况。

这个冬天，你又会留下怎样的新回忆？

（摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2495450]Steam[/url]）
